script: The most attractive women don't get approached by anyone, because everyone assumes she's taken. Here are three steps to break that wall. Everyone looks at her, nobody approaches her. Her beauty became the wall built in their own heads. Step one: the opener. Don't start with her looks. Say: I saw your story from that place. Is it really worth it, or does it just look? That disarms her. Step two: real curiosity. Ask about what she said, because really listening is what separates you from the many. Step three: end with a good, short, concrete way. And if she doesn't reply, don't insist. Comment WALL, and I'll send you a free playbook.
